scenario: A valid, unexpired exception waives a provenance control for one repository; a decision in a sibling repository cites the same exception, and a later decision in the covered repository cites it for a different control.

decisions.subject: repository beta, provenance control, cites the exception
repository alpha, secret-exposure control, cites the exception

when: the policy decision point evaluates both decisions

reasons: an exception applies only within its recorded scope of control and subjects
repository beta is outside the subject scope; the secret-exposure control is outside the control scope
each refusal names the exception, its actual scope, and the unweakened control in force
must_not: stretch an exception to similar subjects or related controls
treat citation of a valid exception as sufficient without scope evaluation
soften the out-of-scope outcome to advisory because an exception exists somewhere
